scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const gId = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID || ''; const gKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || ''; const gModel = process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-1.5-flash'; const scopes = 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile'; fs.writeFileSync('./config.js', `window.APP_CONFIG = { GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: '${gId}', SCOPES: '${scopes}', GEMINI_API_KEY: '${gKey}', GEMINI_MODEL: '${gModel}' };`);"
